verdict.rationale: Devin's docs describe indexing your repositories so Devin understands the codebase, and Devin Review with Auto-Fix responding to code review comments and CI failures, which implies a PR workflow. However, no evidence explicitly documents connecting a GitHub repository or Devin opening pull requests against it. Missing for 10: explicit GitHub connection/integration docs, documented PR creation by the agent, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect a GitHub repository so an agent can access the code and open pull requests against it

citations.quote: Indexing your repositories allows Devin to understand your codebase and enables powerful features like Ask Devin and DeepWiki.
Enable Devin Review with Auto-Fix so Devin automatically responds to code review comments, fixes flagged bugs, and iterates on CI failures
